privacy.s1Body: MyMusicCoach does **not collect any personal data** and does not send any information to external servers.
privacy.s2Body: All your data (exercises, sessions, settings) is stored **only on your device** in the browser's local storage (IndexedDB).
privacy.s4Body: No data is shared with third parties. The export feature creates a file that **only you control**.
privacy.s5Body: Reminders are handled locally on your device. No information is transmitted.
privacy.s6Body: You can delete all your data at any time with the "Reset application" option in the settings.
privacy.s7Body: For any question about this policy, write to us at:
